✅ Fix submitted! PR: https://github.com/zhangjiayang6835-cyber/ai-research/pull/1497

- AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption (replaces ECB)
- Random 96-bit nonce per encryption
- Authentication tag detects tampering
- Key derivation via PBKDF2 with 600K iterations
- File: `fix-1475-ecb-to-gcm.py`
